summary: Kounalakis attended a California Capitol hostage rally in October 2023 and in May 2024 criticized universities for their handling of Palestinian student protests on Gaza. Vote for Peace, which rates candidates on human rights and war-lobby funding, marked her Opposed in the general. CAIR Action listed her as Preferred, a tier below endorsement, and independent activist Samir Laymoun also opposed her. Her documented record reflects Israel-centric framing rather than advocacy for Palestinian justice.
